description: Generate @media print stylesheets: hide nav and ads, pick page size and margins, plus an ink-saver mode, with copyable CSS.

faqs.a: No JavaScript is involved — the output is a pure CSS @media print block.
Add the printed class names to the hide selector, or extend the generated rules with your own selectors.
faqs.q: Can I hide my own elements too?

faqs.a: Yes — the generator covers A4, Letter and Legal, plus portrait or landscape orientation.

howto: Tick the elements to hide when printing (nav, ads, sidebars...).
Choose page size, orientation and margins.
Enable ink-saver to strip backgrounds and dark colors.
Click "Copy CSS" and paste it into your stylesheet.
title: Print Stylesheet Generator
